label: Early copy phase of length-9 sequences (outputting 3rd original token)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or at <DEL>), mostly on long sequences (L=9 holds 90% of mass, L=8 10%, L<=6 none). Peaks at recall_idx 2 (step t=11 for L=9, i.e. input is the fed-back second original token, two steps after <DEL>), with weaker spillover to recall_idx 1 and 3 and a small secondary bump at the last copy steps of L=9 (t=16-17). Never fires on the first occurrence of a token in the sequence (in_first=1 gives zero), so it is never active at t <= L. Within the window, magnitude depends strongly on the input token: v, i, p, 2 give the highest rates and the top activations (e.g. v at t=11), while z, y, m, s, f, q often stay silent. Precision of the position rule is only about 0.4 because of this token dependence; adding a token list raises precision but costs recall, and no simple token set was found.
